commands.about.description: Displays Adamant core and build information.
commands.ban-ip.description: Bans an IP address from the server.
commands.ban.description: Bans a player from the server.
commands.banlist.description: Lists banned players or IP addresses.
commands.clear.description: Clears items from a player's inventory.
commands.clone.description: Copies blocks from one region to another.
commands.data.description: Gets or modifies block and storage data.
commands.deop.description: Revokes operator status from a player.
commands.difficulty.description: Changes or queries the world difficulty.
commands.enchant.description: Adds an enchantment to the held item.
commands.execute.description: Executes a command with a modified context.
commands.experience.description: Adds, sets, or queries player experience.
commands.fill.description: Fills a region with a block.
commands.fillbiome.description: Fills an area with a biome.
commands.gamerule.description: Changes or queries a world game rule.
commands.gc.description: Runs chunk cleanup and triggers a Go garbage collection cycle.
commands.netstat.description: Shows the state of the network connections of players.
commands.help.description: Shows available commands and their usage.
commands.item.description: Replaces or modifies items in inventories.
commands.kick.description: Removes one or more players from the server.
commands.locate.description: Finds a nearby structure, biome, or point of interest.
commands.loot.description: Generates loot from a loot table.
commands.op.description: Grants operator status to a player.
commands.return.description: Returns from the current function with a command result.
commands.ride.description: Makes an entity ride another entity.
commands.say.description: Broadcasts a message to all players.
commands.setblock.description: Sets a block at a position.
commands.setidletimeout.description: Sets the idle timeout in minutes.
commands.spectate.description: Makes a spectator watch through the eyes of an entity.
commands.spreadplayers.description: Spreads players around a center position.
commands.teammsg.description: Send a message to your team.
commands.tellraw.description: Sends a JSON message to players.
commands.time.description: Adjusts or queries the world time.
commands.transfer.description: Transfers a player to another server.
